items.description: The steps in the flow, excluding disabled ones

value.description: The value of the current step, `COMPLETE` past the last step, or `null` when there are no steps

index.description: The position of the current step in the flow

count.description: The number of steps in the flow, excluding disabled ones

complete.description: Whether the stepper has moved past the last step

completedValues.description: The values of the completed steps

hasNextStep.description: Whether the stepper has a next step

hasPreviousStep.description: Whether the stepper has a previous step

canSkip.description: Whether the current step is optional and can be skipped

getItemState.description: Returns the state of the item with the given value

setValue.description: Function to set the value of the stepper

goToNextStep.description: Function to go to the next step

goToPreviousStep.description: Function to go to the previous step

skipStep.description: Function to skip the current step. Only works when the step is optional.

resetStep.description: Function to reset the stepper to its initial state

setCompletedValues.description: Function to set the completed steps

getRootState.description: Returns the state of the root

getCompletedContentProps.description: Returns the props for the content shown once the flow is complete

ids.description: The custom ids for the stepper elements

value.description: The controlled value of the stepper. `COMPLETE` is the position past the last step.

defaultValue.description:
The initial value of the stepper when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the stepper.

onValueChange.description: Callback to be called when the value changes

completedValues.description: The controlled values of the completed steps

defaultCompletedValues.description:
The initial values of the completed steps when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the completed steps.

onCompletedChange.description:
Callback to be called when the completed steps change.
Also fires on `goToNext`, which marks the step it leaves as completed.

onNavigationBlocked.description: Callback to be called when navigation is blocked

onComplete.description:
Callback to be called when the user moves past the last step.
With a controlled value, it fires on each request, whether or not you apply it.

linear.description: If `true`, the stepper requires the user to complete the steps in order

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-complete: Present when the steps value is complete

Item.data-complete: Present when the item value is complete
Item.data-skipped: Present when the flow moved past it without completing it
Item.data-locked: Present when completed and it cannot be returned to

Trigger.data-complete: Present when the trigger value is complete
Trigger.data-skipped: Present when the flow moved past it without completing it
Trigger.data-locked: Present when completed and it cannot be returned to

Content.data-complete: Present when the content value is complete

Indicator.data-complete: Present when the indicator value is complete
Indicator.data-skipped: Present when the flow moved past it without completing it
Indicator.data-locked: Present when completed and it cannot be returned to

Separator.data-complete: Present when the separator value is complete
Separator.data-skipped: Present when the flow moved past it without completing it
Separator.data-locked: Present when completed and it cannot be returned to

Progress.data-complete: Present when the progress value is complete
